Solution 2 has the correct final answer. Its formula $q_{2m+1} = \log_2\!\big(1/\ln\tfrac{2e}{e+1}\big) \approx 1.39636$ matches my independent check.

Solution 1 is wrong: it claims $q = 2$, which does not follow from the midpoint comparison. Solution 3 has the right formula, but its stated numerical value, 1.3678794, is $1+e^{-1}$, not $q_{2m+1}$.

The comparison behind Solution 2 is $E_{\text{int}} - E_{\text{bdy}} = m\,(2e^{-2^{-q}} - 1 - e^{-1})$, which is independent of $m$. Setting it to zero gives $2^{-q} = \ln\tfrac{2e}{e+1} \approx 0.379886$, so $q \approx 1.396363$. A local check shows the interior point at $x = 1/2$ is a local minimizer near this $q$.

CHOICE: 2
CONFIDENCE: 4
